## Self-hosted Umami weekly SEO report

Thursday00:00UTC or manual → current totals and comparison → summary → current and previous page visitor rankings → comparison/five suggestions → one Baserow row. Case study: https://rumjahn.com/how-to-analyze-umami-data-using-n8n-and-a-i-to-improve-seo-and-uncover-hidden-insights-for-better-content-optimization/

## Umami3.4.1

Configure a canonical HTTPS self-hosted /api base,website UUID,site label and timezone in Prepare Report Scope. Select Header Auth Authorization: Bearer <self-hosted API key> on all3Umami reads. A key needs website-view permission. No login/refresh is performed. Canonical endpoints only; redirects fail;30seconds each.

## First analysis

Select OpenRouter Header Auth credentials and replace YOUR_OPENROUTER_MODEL_ID with an available model. The original free model route is not assumed available. Native requests use one user prompt; Open Flow uses a configured gateway AI Agent with additional built-in output/tool instructions. Model results can differ.

## Page rankings

Both ranges use one captured time and one website. They are rolling7×24hour ranges,not calendar weeks. The3.4.1 path metric counts unique visitors; service-default500ranked rows per range,not all paths. Missing from one ranking is unknown,not zero. Full responses are wrapped to avoid multiplying requests.

## Second analysis

Same OpenRouter Header Auth/model setup as first. Compare both ranked responses and ask for a Markdown table and five suggestions. No workflow retry or cross-run deduplication. Review AI conclusions against the source analytics.

## Baserow Cloud

Create Date(date),Summary(long text),Top pages(long text),Blog name(text/long text). Configure Database Token credentials with host https://api.baserow.io and your actual table ID. Native reads field metadata before creating one row. A lost write response may already have created the row; inspect before rerun. See README.
